title: The Regions Below
blurb: The caves under the world aren't all the same. Each region has its own rock, its own life and its own metal.

steps.hint: The first caves under a forest, taiga or jungle. The trees' roots hang through the roof.
The first caves under plains, meadows, savanna or the shore: wide halls of pale limestone.
Deeper under hills and mountains, above y 0: tall cracks where the wind moans.
Deeper under swamps, marshes and the shore, above y 0: halls full of still lakes.
Deeper under deserts, badlands, savanna or frozen land, above y 0: crystals on the walls.
Deeper under forests, plains and hills, above y 0: red ochre stone, iron country.
Below y 0, under any land: great halls of black basalt and ash.
Below y 0, under any land: violet chambers where the Hollows nest. Go ready to fight.

finish.line: You've stood in every region under the world.
